April 15

Father Damien

By Father John Banister Tabb (1845–1909)

Father Damien was a Roman Catholic missionary who devoted his life to the lepers in the government hospital on the island of Molokai, Hawaii. He fell a victim to the disease as he anticipated on April 15, 1889.
O G
OD,
 the cleanest offering
Of tainted earth below,
Unblushing to thy feet we bring—
“A leper white as snow!”
